map.支持多种常见百分比运算（求百分比、增减幅、占比等），输入任意两个已知量即可自动算: Supports several common percentage operations (finding a percentage, increase/decrease, share): enter any two known quantities and the third is computed automatically, for daily and financial ratio work.
map.支持多种常见百分比运算，输入任意两个量即可自动计算。: Supports several common percentage operations; enter any two quantities and it computes automatically.
map.日常与商业中，「A 的 P%」「A 占 B 的百分比」「已知某百分比对应的值反求: In daily life and business the four most common conversions are "P% of A", "A as a percentage of B", "back-solving the whole from a known percentage value" and "percentage increase/decrease".
map.折扣、税率、利润率、完成度、占比等场景，本质都归约为上述四类之一，关键是找准分母: Discounts, tax rates, profit margins, completion rates and share calculations all reduce to one of those four types; the key is finding the right denominator (the base).
map.报表与考试中常混淆『占』与『是』的基准，必须明确百分比的除数，否则结果差一个数量: Reports and exams often confuse the bases of "of" and "is"; the divisor of a percentage must be explicit, otherwise the result is off by an order of magnitude.
map.算例：占比、反求整体与增减: Examples: share, back-solving the whole, and increase/decrease
map.：30 占 200 的百分比 = 30 ÷ 200 × 100 = 15.000: : 30 as a percentage of 200 = 30 / 200 x 100 = 15.0000%; knowing that 15% corresponds to 30, the whole = 30 / (15/100) = 200.0000; going from 200 to 230 gives an increase of (230 - 200) / 200 x 100 = 15.0000% (growth).
map.『A 占 B 的百分比』和『A 是 B 的百分之几』有区别吗？: Is there a difference between "A as a percentage of B" and "A is what percent of B"?
map.计算式相同（A÷B×100%），区别在表述基准：『占』的分母 B 是总量，『是…: The formula is the same (A/B x 100%); the difference is how the base is stated: for "share of", the denominator B is the total, and for "what percent of", the denominator is likewise B. The trap is inverting the denominator, so first decide who is being compared against.
map.增长率和增长百分点有什么区别？: What is the difference between a growth rate and percentage points?
map.增长率是相对变化（(新−旧)÷旧×100%），百分点是两个百分比的绝对差（如 3: A growth rate is a relative change ((new - old)/old x 100%), while percentage points are the absolute difference between two percentages (30% -> 35% is up 5 percentage points, not 5%). Mixing them exaggerates or understates the change.
